nodes.title: Note: DSH_ref2av_2 使用说明
widgets_values:
## DSH_ref2av_2 — 成品视频 → 白模/绿幕视频

把任意【成品视频】里的人换成【纯白无特征人偶】，背景换成【均匀绿幕】，同时精确保留原视频的动作、姿势、节奏与运镜。这是 DSH_ref2av 的逆过程。

### 输入（只有一路）
节点 150 Load Video = 成品源视频。放进 input 后在下拉框选它。

### 三个硬约束
- 源视频必须是 24fps：H3 的 ref_videos 只吃 24fps 帧序列。30fps 源先转码：ffmpeg -i in.mp4 -r 24 -c:a copy out.mp4。
- 时长对齐：节点 132（输出秒数）与节点 151（Trim Video 的 duration）填同一个值（4-15 秒），否则参考片段与输出不等长。帧数由公式自动算（5 秒=124 帧、15 秒=362 帧）。
- 不需要任何参考图：本图没有 LoadImage，ref_images 槽位是空的，白模质感与绿幕完全由 prompt 与模型知识决定。

### 输出
output/video/DSH_ref2av_2，24fps MP4。这是白模+绿幕素材，可直接回头喂给 DSH_ref2av 做正向替换。

### 采样
- Enable Lightning LoRA = False → 20 步完整采样（质量优先）。快速试跑就打开开关 → 4 步 turbo LoRA。
- 这类整段改写任务比正向替换更难（要抹掉原人物的脸/头发/衣服），建议先跑 20 步。

### 提示词
节点 138 已写好 成品到白模与绿幕 的 Ref2VA 六段式 prompt，Video 1 标签 = 源视频。它明确要求：无五官、无头发、无衣物细节、无文字标志、绿幕均匀无渐变、无绿色溢色、逐帧锁定原动作与末帧姿势。

### 效果不理想时依次试
1. 姿势漂移（白模动作与原片不同步）：先确认时长与帧率是否对齐；仍不行则加姿势控制旁路（SDPose 提骨架），但注意 H3 的 Fun ControlNet 需要单独的 minimax_h3_fun_controlnet_union 模型，你磁盘上还没有，需另行下载。
2. 绿幕不纯（有渐变/阴影/溢色）：在 prompt 里把绿的描述写得更具体（例如 flat chroma key green, RGB near zero, one seven seven, six four）。
3. 人物边缘残留原片特征：把节点 132 时长缩短到 5 秒先验证一版，确认模型理解了任务再加长。
4. 调度器从 simple 改 beta（官方模板建议参考类 prompt 用 beta/normal）。

### 反向图的已知取舍
H3 是生成模型不是抠像器：它理解的是语义（把人物变成白色人偶、把背景变成绿幕），而不是几何精确的骨架重绘。若你需要严格一致的白模比例与关节位置，最终方案应是 SDPose/DWPose 提取骨架加白模渲染，而不是文生视频模型。本图给的是最快可用的近似路径。

nodes.title: Input Text (Prompt)
widgets_values:
subject_definitions:
<Video 1> is the source footage: a finished, fully rendered video containing real people or characters in a real environment. It defines the motion, the body poses, the timing, the footfalls, the shot framing and the camera work of the target video. Its surface detail, faces, hair, clothing and background are to be discarded.
<Subject 1> is the motion carrier required by the target video: a featureless matte white humanoid figure with the same body proportions and the same height as each performer in <Video 1>.
<Subject 2> is the required backdrop: a perfectly flat, uniform chroma-key green screen.

summary:
[video editing] The target video reproduces <Video 1> frame for frame in motion, poses, timing and camera work, but every person in it is replaced by <Subject 1>, the featureless white figure, and the entire background is replaced by <Subject 2>, the flat green screen. Nothing of the original appearance or environment survives.

retention_analysis:
<Video 1>: partially_preserved - its motion, body poses, timing, footfalls, shot framing and camera movement are reproduced exactly, while all appearance, clothing, identity and background are deliberately discarded.
<Subject 1>: fully_preserved - every performer is shown as a matte white featureless figure with the same proportions and the same joint articulation in every frame.
<Subject 2>: fully_preserved - the background is a single flat uniform green field in every frame, with no gradient, no scenery, no floor line and no objects.

detailed_description:
The target video is a clean studio reference render: flat, evenly lit, and free of photographic texture. It reproduces <Video 1> exactly in motion and timing while replacing every performer and the whole environment.
[Shot 1] The video opens on the exact framing of <Video 1>. Every person from <Video 1> is replaced in the same position and the same pose by <Subject 1>: a smooth matte white mannequin with no facial features, no eyes, no mouth, no hair and no skin tone, wearing no clothing detail, carrying no logos, no text and no accessories, with visible limb articulation at the shoulders, elbows, hips and knees. The figure's proportions match the performer it replaces, and its feet stay planted exactly where the source feet were. The whole background is <Subject 2>: a single even chroma-key green field that fills the frame behind and around the figure, with no gradient, no horizon line, no floor, no shadow cast onto the green, no scenery and no props. The figure performs exactly the same movement as the source at the same speed, with the same footfalls, weight shifts and gestures, and the camera holds the same framing and follows the same movement as <Video 1>.
[Shot 2] The video continues without any cut, holding the source timing exactly. The white figure stays locked to the source motion frame for frame, keeping the same limb positions, the same head direction and the same balance, with no drift in proportion and no change in the green field. No facial feature, no hair, no clothing pattern, no logo, no text and no second person appears at any point, and no object from the original environment enters the frame. If several performers appear in the source, each one is replaced by its own separate white figure, and the figures never merge. The last frame keeps the same pose and framing as the last frame of <Video 1>.

overall_soundscape:
A clean, empty studio room tone with no dialogue and no music.

non_diegetic_music:
N/A
